how_detail: node holdings-face-driver.mjs (the ~53 driver, unchanged) client mode against portal c3a03c24 built to .scratch/dist-w58 (same bundle hash index-BHGl-JjQ as portal/dist): Securities table SGM1 130.00% / $650,000.00 and Sample Client Fund 20.00% / $100,000.00, map 130.0% and 20.0%, card $1,000,000.00. weight_base.what: pctOfTotal: node.percentages.of_total -- the served per-node fraction, read straight; SecurityList.tsx:239 `weight: n.pctOfTotal` (HoldingsTreemap.tsx:454 sums the served pctOfTotal over one security identity). The page divides by nothing: the denominator is the producer's (node.amount.denominator.value, UNIQUE_CUSTODY_TOTAL). For a client-level view the one-account fold (SecurityList.tsx foldSecurityRows, sumOrNull) adds the served weights of the same security across accounts and the served amounts alike.

reason: the page computes no weight; it prints the served of_total. The all-accounts body the harness served carried each ACCOUNT's own share (SGM1 0.6 and 0.7, Client Fund 0.1 and 0.1, denominator 500000) beside a card total of 1,000,000 -- inconsistent numbers a real answer would not carry. They were changed in the body after the fixture file was written: the ~53 driver's oneBody() filters ALL_BODY.data.nodes without copying the node objects and then rewrites of_total and denominator on them, so the all-accounts body it served later was already rewritten.
what_the_fixture_gets_wrong: holdings-face.no-pick.fixture.json itself is consistent (of_total = amount / 1,000,000 on every node, SGM1 0.30 + 0.35 = 0.65). What was served is not: holdings-face-driver.mjs line 51 `body.data.nodes = nodes.filter(...)` shares node objects with ALL_BODY, and lines 56-57 set n.amount.denominator.value = account total and n.percentages.of_total = amount / account total on those shared nodes. Served all-accounts body after that: N-A-SEC 300000/500000 = 0.6, N-B-SEC 350000/500000 = 0.7 (sum 1.3), the four CLI/SMA nodes at 0.1 each (Client Fund sum 0.2). Measured: served-body-check.mjs (before 0.3/0.35 over 1000000, after-shared 0.6/0.7 over 500000, after-copied 0.3/0.35). With nodes copied (holdings-face-driver.fixed.mjs, one line) the same page reads 65.00% / $650,000.00 and 10.00% / $100,000.00 (weight-130.fixed-driver-client.png) and, picked on one account, 70% / 20% / 10% tiles. Page source at c3a03c24 rendered through parseIrEnvelope + HoldingsTab with the unmutated body (temporary probe test, deleted): 65.00% and 10.00%.

producer_fixture.carries: instance: one account A-0001, custody_totals.total_market_value 500000.0, node N-1 amount 125000.0, denominator {kind UNIQUE_CUSTODY_TOTAL, value 500000.0}, of_total 0.25 = 125000 / 500000. So a real answer's of_total is amount over the SAME UNIQUE_CUSTODY_TOTAL value the answer carries; the producer fixture has only one account, so it shows no multi-account case and says nothing about a two-account client beyond that rule.
